acceptance.statement: The loop-control tests fail closed when they inherit a Pantheon dev or production DATABASE_URL.
Real database tests require an explicit test DSN, use a unique schema, and leave no rows or schema behind.
A regression captures the legitimate loop_controller_records count and digest before and after the suite and proves they are unchanged.
The cleanup utility is dry-run by default and targets only enumerated test contamination rows.
Human/Ops evidence is required before live cleanup and legitimate source_ingestion and strategy_distillation rows are preserved.
The task is delivered by PR to dev with green checks and independent Codex review.
